source_claim: AlphaEvolve prompts require proposed SEARCH/REPLACE edits to be consistent with each other, including companion edits such as adding a config variable when another replacement uses it
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include runtime.history.mutation_consistency_report for generated multi-edit candidate inventories, changed structured edit units, changed file or block ids, diagnostic cochange links, best-effort Python symbol scans, unresolved-reference diagnostics, evaluator failure-taxonomy linkage, and candidate status/admission records. It does not claim language-aware scope resolution, config or resource dependency models, required companion-edit inference, cross-file dataflow or import resolution, benchmark-calibrated consistency failures, hard or configurable acceptance gates, or semantic consistency proof.
